messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning an evening deploy for console/ui at 22:00 UTC (in ~40m). Staggered canary -> 50% -> 100%. Need one person to run smoke checks and someone to trigger CDN edge invalidation 5m before full rollout. :wave:

alex: Key asks: 1) confirm asset hash is bumped, 2) confirm CDN invalidation path list, 3) who is on monitoring/watch, 4) rollback plan pinned. Posting quick checklist below.

alex: Smoke checklist:
- sanity: https://console.redwood.ai/health returns 200
- auth/login flow check
- spot-check main app bundle served with new hash
- a few key routes render (dashboard, projects, billing)

alex: Invalidation plan (edge):
- run 5m before full rollout:
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E123ABC --paths "/static/*" "/console/*"
```
If distribution is Fastly, use purge-by-key for hashes.

meli: I'll be on smoke at the start of the canary. Can run the health + basic UX flows. :eyes:

meli: Quick note — I saw an extra SRI attr in main.js PR; confirmed asset hash is bumped in prod-manifest. LGTM from my side.

sasha: Reviewed ui PRs earlier, left a small nits but nothing blocking. Can be on deploy in 22:00 slot. :+1:

jamie: I can trigger the CDN invalidation right before full rollout and watch edge 4xx/5xx rates for 15m. Will post timestamps when run.

ryan: Will monitor Sentry and synthetic checks during canary. If error rate > 0.5% or spike in latency, I'll flip the canary to rollback.

alex: Rollback options:
- immediate: abort rollout and switch traffic back via rollout tool (canary -> previous)
- code revert: `git revert <deploy-commit>` + redeploy if needed
- emergency: use feature flag to turn off new UI via console-ff endpoint

alex: Minimal commands if rollback needed:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/console-ui --to-revision=<previous>
# or via deploy-api
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/rollout -d '{"service":"console-ui","target":"previous"}'
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @alex for 1798767600 (2026-03-17 22:40:00 UTC). Canary window: 10m, metrics check at +5m and +10m.

meli: Copy. I'll start manual smoke at canary +2m and post results.

jamie: I'll run invalidation at canary +9m (5m before full). Will share invalidation id.

sasha: leaving a quick reminder — make sure CDN cache-control for static assets is long and we rely on hash invalidation only. No stale-while-revalidate on main bundle.

alex: Good call. I've removed SWR header in the build config for this release.

ryan: If anyone wants me to run an extra synthetic (login -> open dashboard -> open project), ping me and I'll add a job to run once the canary goes live.

meli: smoke results: health=200, login flow OK, main.js contains new hash, dashboard renders. No errors in console on quick pass. :thumbsup:

jamie: invalidation run: id=INV_20260317_001 (CloudFront). Paths: /static/*, /console/*, /assets/* — started at 22:09 UTC.

ryan: metrics quiet so far — latency steady, errors normal. I'll keep watching for 15m.

alex: Thanks everyone — proceeding to 50% in 2m. If no regressions, we'll go to full at +10m. I'll post final confirmation when 100% is done. :rocket:

sasha: Thanks team. I'll be by for rollback if needed.

alex: 100% done. No major issues reported in the 15m window. Closing this thread — filing post-deploy notes in #deploy-archive later. :tada:
